task_prompt: Write a Qiskit program that prepares an arbitrary state with amplitudes proportional to [0.24, 0.94, 0.25, 0.28] using StatePreparation, then verifies the prepared statevector matches the normalized target. Give one complete script that runs end-to-end on its own and prints the outcome.
